# codex-vscode-health

> codex-vscode-health is a free, open-source (MIT), experimental bash health gate for VS Code Remote hosts. It checks memory, swap, load, disk, duplicate helper processes, extensionHost count, ~/.codex size, Codex extension installs and AI extension pile-up, which are the server-side pressures behind the Codex VS Code extension failing with renderer_ready_timeout while the codex app-server backend is healthy. Run bin/vscode-health.sh (read-only) or bin/vscode-health.sh --fix (safe fixes only). Exit codes: 0 healthy, 1 warning, 2 critical.

Not affiliated with OpenAI or Microsoft. Thresholds are tuned from a single documented incident on a 6 vCPU, 7.8G host, so treat them as a starting point.

## Docs

- [Runbook](https://github.com/MHJoy99/codex-vscode-health/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md): step-by-step triage when the renderer times out
- [Full plain-text description for LLMs](https://mhjoy99.github.io/codex-vscode-health/llms-full.txt): everything in one file
